passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations together with the consolidated financial statements and related notes that are included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements based upon current plans, expectations and beliefs that involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under “Risk Factors” and elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Overview In a world where data is increasingly a precious commodity and competitive differentiator, Arista was founded to enable our customers to access all their centers of data in the quickest, most reliable, and secure manner. Over the last two decades, we have emerged as an industry leader, delivering data-driven, client-to-cloud networking-as-a-service. Our “Centers of Data” strategy is a fundamental pivot from legacy networking approaches that create incongruent silos to a unified, data-driven approach in which the network is a service that interconnects four primary domains: AI Centers, Data Centers, Campus Centers, and WAN Centers. Anchored by Arista’s state-oriented Extensible Operating System (EOS) and Network Data Lake (NetDL), our network-as-a-service platform delivers a seamless, consolidated networking experience regardless of data location Our solutions are differentiated because they: • offer uncompromising reliability derived from the foundation of robust quality assurance capabilities, and a suite of automated diagnostics; • are based on advanced open and standards-based technology that avoids what is often expensive vendor lock-in, and • provide consistent real-time telemetry and intelligent automation to decrease the manual workload on the operator. This strategy and differentiation have also allowed us to deliver our comprehensive suite of products, services, and technologies to a global customer base segmented into three primary categories: Cloud and AI Titans, AI and Specialty Providers, and Enterprise. Market research confirms that we continue to be a leader in high-speed Ethernet switching. The percentage of revenue derived from these customers during the current fiscal year was approximately 48% from Cloud and AI Titans, 32% from Enterprise and 20% from AI and Specialty Providers. Arista established itself as a market leader with platforms, products, and people to enable some of these hyperscalers’ most consequential networks. Our network-as-a-service approach now empowers customers of all sizes to seamlessly leverage their data through offerings spanning three key categories: Core (AI, Cloud, and Data Center Networking), Cognitive Adjacencies (Campus and Routing), and Cognitive Networks (Software and Services). The percentage of revenue derived from these product categories during the current fiscal year was approximately 65% from Core, 18% from Cognitive Adjacencies, and 17% from Software and Services. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should consider carefully the risks and uncertainties described below, together with all of the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, which could materially affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects. The risks described below are not the only risks facing us. Risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem to be immaterial may also materially affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects. Risk Factors Summary Our business is subject to numerous risks and uncertainties. credit_strengths.text: Arista's revenue and operating income have compounded strongly across the three-year trend, with operating margin well above the Information Technology sector median and near the top sector percentile. This reflects pricing power and operating leverage in high-speed Ethernet switching, where the issuer holds a leadership position across AI, cloud, data center, campus and WAN domains.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure many times over, leaving substantial free cash flow after capex. The current ratio also sits comfortably above the sector median, and the Altman Z double-prime zone is Safe, indicating a liquid, conservatively financed balance sheet with ample internal funding capacity.

key_risks.text: Disclosed risk factors flag concentration: a limited number of large customers represent a substantial portion of revenue, with Cloud and AI Titans alone contributing roughly half of the total. Loss of, or reduced spending by, any single hyperscaler customer would materially affect revenue and cash generation.

The risk factors also cite sole or limited sources of supply for key components, extended lead times and supply changes, plus tariff and retaliatory trade measures. These could raise input costs, delay shipments and pressure gross margins, which the issuer itself expects to vary over time.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: No funded debt was identified from standard tags for the balance-sheet date, and no debt maturities are disclosed. Cash on hand and annual free cash flow together dwarf any plausible refinancing need, so debt service capacity appears exceptionally strong on the evidence available.

Interest expense and total debt are not available, so interest coverage and leverage cannot be computed. This is a material gap for a full credit assessment, though the absence of borrowing tags and the Safe zone suggest the gap reflects a debt-free structure rather than hidden leverage.

overall_credit_view.text: Our analyst judgement is that Arista presents a high-quality credit profile: strong revenue growth, sector-leading operating margins, robust free cash flow and a liquid balance sheet. The indicative financial risk profile is constrained only by missing debt and interest data, not by observed weakness.

Shareholder distributions and acquisitions absorb a meaningful share of free cash flow, but internal generation still covers them comfortably. We would view leverage as conservative if confirmed debt-free; the key monitoring points are customer concentration, supply-chain and tariff exposure, and margin variability rather than refinancing risk.

credit_strengths.text: Arista 的營收與營業利益在三年趨勢中強勁複合增長，營業利潤率遠高於資訊科技行業中位數，並接近行業最高百分位。這反映其在高速乙太網交換領域的定價能力與營運槓桿，發行人在 AI、雲端、數據中心、園區及廣域網路領域均佔據領導地位。
營運現金流覆蓋資本開支多倍，扣除資本開支後仍留下可觀的自由現金流。流動比率亦穩居行業中位數之上，而 Altman Z 雙重質數區間為安全，顯示資產負債表流動性充裕、融資保守，並具備充足的內部融資能力。

key_risks.text: 披露的風險因素指出集中度問題：少數大型客戶佔收入相當大比重，僅雲端與 AI 巨頭就貢獻約一半總收入。失去任何單一超大規模客戶，或該客戶減少支出，將對收入及現金生成造成重大影響。
風險因素亦提及關鍵組件的單一或有限供應來源、延長的交貨時間及供應變化，以及關稅與報復性貿易措施。這些可能推高投入成本、延遲出貨並對毛利率構成壓力，而發行人本身亦預期毛利率會隨時間波動。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 從資產負債表日期的標準標籤中未識別出任何有資金支持的債務，亦未披露任何債務到期日。手頭現金與年度自由現金流合計遠超任何可能的再融資需求，因此根據現有證據，債務償付能力似乎異常強勁。
利息支出與總債務數據不可得，故無法計算利息覆蓋率與槓桿比率。這是全面信用評估的重大缺口，儘管缺乏借款標籤及處於安全區間，表明該缺口反映的是無債務結構，而非隱藏槓桿。

overall_credit_view.text: 我們的分析師判斷是，Arista 呈現高質量的信用狀況：強勁的收入增長、行業領先的營業利潤率、穩健的自由現金流及流動性充裕的資產負債表。指示性財務風險狀況僅受缺失債務與利息數據所限，而非觀察到的弱點。
股東分派與收購佔用自由現金流中相當比重，但內部生成仍能輕鬆覆蓋。若確認無債務，我們會視槓桿為保守；關鍵監測點是客戶集中度、供應鏈與關稅風險，以及利潤率波動性，而非再融資風險。
